name: Shimano seven-speed cassette (I group)
weight_description: Weight withheld because the manufacturer references conflict: the 1991 105 SC table lists 286 g including spacers, while the same edition’s RX100 table lists 325 g for the same seven-speed I-group 13–23T cassette. The earlier RX100 reference also gives 325 g. No distinguishing weighed variant is identified.

technical_document.title: Shimano CS-HG70 exploded view and replacement parts

sources.title: Shimano Dealers’ 1990 Product Manual, page 28: RX100 component specifications and weights (published August 1989; archived by Disraeli Gears)

Shimano 1991 dealer catalogue, printed page 40 (PDF page 43): RX100 CS-HG70 I-group 13–23T cassette, conflicting 325 g reference; manufacturer scan hosted by Vintage Cannondale
